description: Rent-a-Bot: end. WHEN: end a rental early (renter or owner). Settles in one atomic step: renter ending pays the owner for time used (per minute, min 1 credit) and refunds the rest; mode=job with completed=true pays the full job. Owner ending (cancel) refunds the renter for all unused time (a job is fully refunded). Idempotent: ending an already-settled rental returns its receipt. Registered key required. Example: rent_end {"hire_id":"<hire_id>"}

completed.description: Renter only, mode=job: true = job done, release full escrow to owner.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only; guest keys cannot rent.

name: rent_end
title: Rent-a-Bot: end a rental
